subject: Invoice dispute — March overage & VAT on credit
messages:
From: Carlos Sanchez <c.sanchez@brightskyhealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: emma.jones@brightskyhealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 Mar 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dispute: March invoice overage and VAT on credits

Hi Monica,

We've been reviewing our March invoice and noticed two items we'd like to dispute: a ~$1,200 overcharge tied to burst autoscaling (line item 12) and VAT being applied to the service credit referenced on page 2. I have attached the PDF of the invoice (Invoice_2025-03.pdf).

Quick summary:
- Invoice #2025-03-BS shows a burst usage charge on 2025-03-12 that appears duplicated in two line items.
- Your team issued a provisional service credit but VAT was still charged on the credit amount. In our jurisdiction (UK subsidiary), credits should reduce the VAT due on the invoice.

Could you confirm:
1) Whether the burst charge was double-billed and, if so, the corrected credit amount (net + VAT).
2) A corrected invoice/credit memo we can upload to our AP system (we need new invoice and credit memo numbers).
3) ETA for resolution — our payment run is scheduled for 2025-04-02, so we'd appreciate resolution before then.

Thanks — Carlos
Carlos Sanchez
Billing Lead, BrightSky Health
c.sanchez@brightskyhealth.com
Attachment: Invoice_2025-03.pdf (PDF, 312KB)

From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: Carlos Sanchez <c.sanchez@brightskyhealth.com>
Cc: emma.jones@brightskyhealth.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Mar 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dispute: March invoice overage and VAT on credits

Hi Carlos — thanks for flagging this and for the clear summary.

I've looped in Aditya (sales ops) to pull the usage logs and Evelyn (finance) to coordinate the credit memo and tax treatment. Initial steps we will take:
- Aditya will validate the March 12 burst usage lines and check for any duplication in billing records.
- Evelyn will confirm VAT handling and prepare a corrected credit memo + corrected invoice if applicable.
- We will provisionally hold payment processing until we confirm the adjustment (or issue a credit you can apply).

Could you please confirm BrightSky's VAT registration number (if applicable) and the legal billing entity that receives invoices? That will speed the corrected paperwork.

Target ETA: 3-5 business days for an initial resolution/credit memo; we will escalate if we need faster turnaround.

I attached a quick usage export we think will help (usage_export_BS-0325.csv).

Best,
Monica Patel

On Tue, 25 Mar 2025 10:03:00 -07:00 monica.patel@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Carlos — thanks for flagging this and for the clear summary.
> I've looped in Aditya (sales ops) to pull the usage logs and Evelyn (finance) to coordinate the credit memo and tax treatment.

Investigation notes (brief):
- Root cause: an autoscale reconciliation bug allowed the March 12 burst session to be counted twice when a cancel/replace sequence occurred during a rolling upgrade.
- Impact: duplicated token billing for session IDs BS-4321 and BS-4322. Net overcharge (before VAT) = $1,200.
- Proposed corrective action: issue a goodwill/service credit of $1,200 + VAT (if VAT applies) and generate a corrected invoice and credit memo.
- Recommended goodwill credit number: CM-BS-123 (prelim).

Evelyn: please confirm the tax treatment (VAT) and whether we should issue the credit gross or net. Carlos / Emma: can you confirm the billing/legal entity name and VAT ID so we can prepare the paperwork correctly?

If Finance approves, I'll create the calculation worksheet and proposed line-item credit for your review.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
